message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical method used for binary classification problems. It models the probability that a given input belongs to one of two classes (e.g., success/failure, yes/no) by fitting a logistic function to the data. The logistic function, also known as the sigmoid function, maps any real-valued number into the interval (0, 1), which can be interpreted as a probability. The model estimates parameters (weights) that maximize the likelihood of observing the given outcomes. Once trained, logistic regression can predict class labels by thresholding the predicted probabilities (commonly at 0.5).
